title: CRITICAL: Fix SSR path resolution for convex imports
description: Page fails to load with error: 'Failed to load url ../../convex/_generated/api'. This is a Vite SSR issue where relative imports to convex generated files fail during server-side rendering. All other work is blocked until this is fixed.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Check if convex dev server is running (npx convex dev)
Verify vite.config.ts has proper resolve.alias for convex paths
Consider changing relative imports to use path alias (@convex/)
Clear .vinxi cache and node_modules/.vite, restart servers
Song page renders with video and lyrics
